information.description:
Zealots have bought into the manta of Maelstrom’s beliefs full-sale, and not only preach this to their peers, but also act as the gang’s internal security. They often roll with a partner and aren’t super combat focused themselves, but their heap of extra cyberware and experience can still make them a very dangerous opponent in the right situation.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Maelstrom).

description.value: Generic Heavy Melee Weapon.

Unity is often sought after, but difficult to achieve. After all, Night City is a city of individualists, anarchists and warring gangs. To unite under a shared banner, you'll need a persuasive argument – preferably cast from lead. The designers responsible for the Unity understood this well. This universal, inexpensive pistol has resolved countless conflicts and put a stop to disputes. Dissatisfied customers, betrayed spouses, impatient drivers stuck in traffic – chances are they'll pull out a Unity.

Cost: 250eb (Premium)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 3 • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6).

Range: Pistol

Run the edge at top speed, choomba. There ain’t another way to live.

Speedware. As an Action, the user may activate this cyberware, after which it remains active for the next 60 seconds (20 Rounds). While active, this cyberware provides a +3 bonus to any Initiative Roll made. If activated while the user is already in an Initiative Queue, their current Initiative increases by 3, which is lost if this cyberware deactivates or its duration expires during combat. This cyberware has a 1 hour cooldown before it can be activated again. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Sandevistan; use this one instead of the core item.
  • Matches the core item's setup: the +3 shows as a toggle in the initiative roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
Range: 1 mile. In-ear.

Cost Per Dose: 150eb (Expensive)

A Maelstrom modification to typical Black Lace that vaporizes it to minimize side effects in exchange for it only working with certain kinds of inhalers and metabolizing much quicker, resulting in a shorter high.

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 1 hour.
  • User takes 1d6 Humanity Loss that is returned if the user isn’t affected by S-KEEF’s Secondary Effect.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user ignores the effects of the Seriously Wounded Wound State.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV17) ⋘

  • Humanity Loss from S-KEEF’s Primary Effect isn’t returned.
  • If the user wasn’t already addicted to S-KEEF, they are now. While addicted, unless the user is currently experiencing the Primary Effect of S-KEEF, their REF is reduced by 2.

⋙ SPECIAL FEATURES⋘

  • This drug can only be consumed via a Maxdoc Inhaler, and is not compatible with Airhypos, Arrowhypo Ammunition, Multihypos, or similar devices. It can still be loaded into Airburst Ammunition and other aerosol-based application methods.

NOTE: This is based on how Dum Dum in 2077 calls his specific batch of Black Lace ‘S-KEEF’ and directly mentions the aerosol version reducing its downsides.

Cost: 150eb (Expensive) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "S-KEEF Addiction" effect.
  • When an addicted character doses, use "S-KEEF Addicted Primary" instead of the normal primary effect; it cancels the withdrawal penalties for the duration.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.
